# E05: Pseudoreplication and false-positive control in spatial differential expression

**Question.** Do spot-level tests (the common default and 3D-STIAS V4.4.1) produce false discoveries when groups differ only by section/donor, and does replicate-aware pseudobulk testing control them?

## Notes and limitations

- Part B is semi-synthetic: real counts with a known effect added by binomial thinning; it is labelled so in every file name.
- Splits are balanced within donor so donor effects are not confounded with group; remaining false positives from spot-level tests come from section-level variation treated as replication.
- Genes expressed in at least 5% of spots of the layer are tested.
